faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Canbebe products and our AI guide.

q1.q: Are Canbebe products safe for newborns?
q1.a: Yes — all Canbebe products are dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic and formulated without parabens, sulfates or artificial fragrances. They are specifically designed for the delicate skin of newborns and premature babies.

q2.q: How does the AI Mama Guide work?
q2.a: Our AI assistant is trained on thousands of pediatric and maternal health resources. Simply type your question in the chat — whether it's about feeding schedules, sleep routines, or product recommendations — and receive personalised guidance instantly, 24 hours a day.

q3.q: What diaper size should I choose?
q3.a: We recommend choosing by weight: S (up to 5kg), M (5–9kg), L (9–14kg), XL (14kg+). If your baby is between sizes, go up — a slightly larger diaper is more comfortable and helps prevent leaks. Our AI assistant can also help you find the perfect fit.

q5.q: Can I return a product if my baby has a reaction?
q5.a: Absolutely. Your baby's comfort and safety is our top priority. We offer a full 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you experience any issues, contact our support team and we will arrange a full refund or exchange — no questions asked.

q6.q: How do I create an account?
q6.a: Click "Sign Up" in the top navigation, enter your name, email and password. Once registered you can track orders, save favourite products and access your full chat history with the AI Mama Guide.
